The index has a knn_vector field holding each document's embedding. Enter the index name as the Vector Store ID, or under Index Name when another endpoint already uses that ID
You know which embedding model created those embeddings. That model must be added to this proxy under Models so you can pick it below. Using a different model returns wrong results
